# Editor completion report: <issue/outcome>

Post the completed report on the issue/PR, or link to the feature's existing run record. Mark each claim passed, failed or not checked. Fill only applicable fields; explain omissions. Follow [editor contributions](../agents/editor-contributions.md).

- **State:** <complete, partial or blocked; branch and tested/reviewed head or explicit uncommitted source state>
- **Environment:** <host, pinned engine/build, map and observation time when relevant>
- **Changed inventory:** <every created/modified/deleted source file, map, Blueprint, widget, material and imported asset; distinguish transient objects from saved packages>
- **Acceptance and preservation:** <each brief criterion and preserved behavior, its result and supporting evidence>
- **Tool outcomes:** <compile/import/save operations and explicit returned results; failures, ambiguous responses and unresolved side effects>
- **Persistence:** <individual save outcomes, full dirty-package status and save/reload check when applicable>
- **Checks:** <exact commands or interaction steps, executed counts/results; new log errors/warnings from this operation>
- **Visual/input evidence:** <accessible selected captures/recordings and what was inspected; manual steps completed by whom, or still pending>
- **Provenance:** <entries in docs/assets.md and editable source locations, if assets were introduced>
- **Review:** <independent Standards/Spec outcomes, fixed or declined findings, reviewed baseline/head>
- **Handback:** <last observed editor/PIE/dirty state and owner; preserved unfinished work, limits and next action>

Keep bulk output in ignored evidence directories. Attach selected evidence to the
issue/PR or another team-accessible location; a local path alone is not accessible
review evidence. A successful build or headless startup does not establish rendered
appearance, input or game feel. Leave those claims pending until observed.
